check_title: Root account has active access keys
detail: No root access keys found.
remediation: Delete the root access keys, enable SCPs/Organizations and use IAM roles with temporary credentials.

check_title: Root account does not have MFA enabled
detail: Root MFA enabled.
remediation: Enable a hardware MFA device on the root account immediately.

check_title: IAM user access keys older than 90 days
detail: Access key AKIASTALE98765 is 210 days old (limit 90).
remediation: Rotate keys and prefer roles/SSO for humans and short-lived credentials for workloads.

detail: Console user does not have MFA enabled.
remediation: Require MFA for all console users (e.g. via an IAM policy denying console access without MFA).

check_title: IAM policies granting full administrative privileges
detail: No policies grant blanket administrative access.
remediation: Replace full-admin policies with scoped, least-privilege policies; audit usage with IAM Access Analyzer.

check_title: IAM password policy is weak or missing
detail: Password policy meets minimum hardening requirements.
remediation: Configure a compliant password policy in IAM.

detail: No buckets found publicly accessible.
remediation: Block public access at account level (BlockPublicAcl / BlockPublicPolicy) and keep ACLs off.

detail: Default encryption (SSE) is not enabled.
remediation: Enable SSE-S3 or SSE-KMS as the bucket default.

detail: Versioning is disabled; deleted/overwritten objects cannot be recovered.
remediation: Enable versioning; pair with lifecycle rules for cost control.

detail: Server access logging is disabled; no audit trail of object-level access.
remediation: Enable server access logging to a dedicated logging bucket.

check_title: Security group exposes management ports to the internet
detail: Security group exposes ports [22] to 0.0.0.0/0.
remediation: Restrict ingress to known CIDRs/VPC endpoints; use AWS Systems Manager Session Manager instead of SSH.

check_title: Security group exposes management ports to the internet
detail: Security group exposes ports [3306] to 0.0.0.0/0.
remediation: Restrict ingress to known CIDRs/VPC endpoints; use AWS Systems Manager Session Manager instead of SSH.

check_title: EBS volume not encrypted at rest
detail: EBS volume is not encrypted at rest.
remediation: Enable EBS encryption by default at the account level.

check_title: Public AMI shared with all AWS accounts
detail: AMI is public; any AWS account can launch instances from it.
remediation: Make AMIs private; share explicitly with trusted accounts.

check_title: Public instance attached to open security group
detail: Instance has a public IP and is attached to a security group exposing management ports.
remediation: Move instances into private subnets behind a bastion/ALB; scope security groups to the minimum required.

detail: RDS instance is publicly accessible.
remediation: Disable public accessibility and place RDS in private subnets.

detail: RDS storage encryption is disabled.
remediation: Enable RDS encryption (may require re-creation).

detail: Backup retention is 3 days (recommended >= 7).
remediation: Set automated backup retention to at least 7 days.

detail: SNS topic policy allows public subscription/publish.
remediation: Restrict topic policies to trusted principals and actions.

detail: CloudTrail is configured but: log file integrity validation disabled.
remediation: Enable a multi-region trail with log file validation and an S3/KMS backed log store.

detail: AWS Config recorder is not running.
remediation: Enable the Config recorder and delivery channel.

detail: KMS key rotation is disabled.
remediation: Enable automatic yearly rotation for symmetric customer keys.

detail: ECR repository policy allows public pulls.
remediation: Set repository policy to deny public access and enforce private-only pulls.

detail: Lambda uses end-of-life runtime python3.7.
remediation: Migrate to a supported runtime (e.g. python3.12, nodejs20.x).

detail: The default VPC exists and is in use; it ships with permissive routing and no guard rails.
remediation: Delete the default VPC (or stop using it) and deploy workloads in purpose-built VPCs.

detail: VPC flow logging is not enabled; network traffic cannot be audited or forensically reconstructed.
remediation: Enable flow logs on every VPC to a centralized log destination.

detail: NACL contains an inbound allow-all rule from 0.0.0.0/0, bypassing subnet-level filtering.
remediation: Replace allow-all NACL entries with explicit allow rules for required traffic.

check_title: Default security group allows open ingress
detail: The default security group allows ingress from 0.0.0.0/0; default groups should have no inbound rules.
remediation: Remove all inbound rules from default security groups.

detail: EBS encryption by default is not enabled; new volumes are created unencrypted unless specified.
remediation: Enable EBS encryption by default and use a CMK where required.

check_title: EC2 instance does not require IMDSv2
detail: Instance does not require IMDSv2 (session-based tokens); the SSRF risk profile is higher.
remediation: Enforce IMDSv2 (HttpTokens=required) on instances and AMIs.

check_title: EC2 instance does not require IMDSv2
detail: Instance does not require IMDSv2 (session-based tokens); the SSRF risk profile is higher.
remediation: Enforce IMDSv2 (HttpTokens=required) on instances and AMIs.

detail: Instance termination protection is disabled; a stray terminate API call destroys it.
remediation: Enable disableApiTermination on production instances.

detail: Instance termination protection is disabled; a stray terminate API call destroys it.
remediation: Enable disableApiTermination on production instances.

detail: Detailed CloudWatch monitoring is disabled on the instance.
remediation: Enable detailed monitoring on critical instances.

detail: Detailed CloudWatch monitoring is disabled on the instance.
remediation: Enable detailed monitoring on critical instances.

check_title: No alarm for root account usage
detail: No alarm for root account usage - alarm present.
remediation: Create a metric filter + alarm for RootAccountUsageEvent.

check_title: No alarm for IAM policy changes
detail: No alarm for IAM policy changes - alarm present.
remediation: Create a metric filter + alarm for IAM PolicyEvent changes.

detail: Disabling or misconfiguring CloudTrail removes the audit trail - changes must alert.
remediation: Create a metric filter + alarm for CloudTrail events.

check_title: No alarm for console sign-in without MFA
detail: Sign-ins without MFA indicate a bypass or a compromised password.
remediation: Create a metric filter + alarm for ConsoleLogin without MFA.

detail: NACL changes alter subnet traffic filtering; unexpected changes must alert.
remediation: Create a metric filter + alarm for NetworkAcl events.

check_title: No alarm for security group changes
detail: Security group changes can open ports to the internet.
remediation: Create a metric filter + alarm for SecurityGroup events.

check_title: No alarm for S3 bucket policy changes
detail: Bucket policy changes can make data public.
remediation: Create a metric filter + alarm for PutBucketPolicy events.

check_title: No alarm for KMS key changes
detail: KMS key deletion/disabling destroys or locks data.
remediation: Create a metric filter + alarm for KMS key events.

check_title: No alarm for unauthorized API calls
detail: Repeated denied API calls are a classic attack signal.
remediation: Create a metric filter + alarm for UnauthorizedOperation events.

check_title: No alarm for failed console sign-ins
detail: Brute-force and credential-stuffing attempts produce failed sign-ins.
remediation: Create a metric filter + alarm for ConsoleLogin failures.

detail: GuardDuty is enabled with an active detector.
remediation: Enable GuardDuty with an active detector and integrate findings into your SIEM.

detail: Secret rotation is disabled; a leaked secret keeps working indefinitely.
remediation: Enable automatic rotation (every 30-90 days) for all secrets.

detail: In-use certificate expires in 12 day(s); renew immediately to avoid service outage.
remediation: Enable automatic renewal or monitor certificate expiry.

detail: CloudTrail is actively logging.
remediation: Verify trail status shows IsLogging true and fix the delivery configuration.

detail: SQS queue policy allows anonymous SendMessage.
remediation: Restrict queue policies to trusted principals.

detail: SQS queue does not use server-side encryption.
remediation: Enable SSE (SQS-managed or KMS) on all queues.

detail: Point-in-time recovery is disabled; data can only be restored to the last backup.
remediation: Enable PITR on all production tables.

detail: Table is not encrypted with a KMS key.
remediation: Configure KMS customer-managed keys for tables.

detail: Redshift cluster is publicly accessible.
remediation: Disable public accessibility and place clusters in private subnets.

detail: All Redshift clusters are encrypted.
remediation: Enable cluster encryption (may require re-creation).

detail: Redshift audit logging is disabled.
remediation: Enable audit logging to S3/CloudWatch.

detail: EFS file system is not encrypted at rest.
remediation: Recreate the file system with encryption enabled.

detail: EFS file system has no automatic backup policy.
remediation: Attach an AWS Backup policy to the file system.

detail: ElastiCache cluster is not encrypted at rest.
remediation: Enable at-rest encryption on the cluster.

detail: ElastiCache cluster does not encrypt traffic in transit.
remediation: Enable in-transit encryption (Redis AUTH).

detail: Deletion protection is disabled; the database can be deleted accidentally or maliciously.
remediation: Enable deletion protection on all production instances.

detail: RDS instance is not Multi-AZ; failover on AZ loss is unavailable.
remediation: Enable Multi-AZ deployment.

detail: Load balancer has no HTTPS/TLS listener; client traffic is plaintext.
remediation: Add HTTPS/TLS listeners and redirect HTTP to HTTPS.

detail: Load balancer access logging is disabled.
remediation: Enable access logs to a centralized S3 bucket.

detail: Load balancer access logging is disabled.
remediation: Enable access logs to a centralized S3 bucket.

check_title: EKS cluster API endpoint publicly accessible
detail: EKS cluster API endpoint is publicly accessible.
remediation: Disable public endpoint access and use private endpoints with authorized CIDRs.

detail: API Gateway stage has no access logging or method settings.
remediation: Enable access logging and method settings on all stages.

detail: DNSSEC is not enabled on any hosted zone; DNS responses can be spoofed.
remediation: Enable DNSSEC signing on production hosted zones.

check_title: Account-level S3 block public access disabled
detail: Account-level S3 block public access is not fully enabled.
remediation: Enable all four block public access settings at account level.

detail: Distribution is not associated with an AWS WAF web ACL; no L7 filtering.
remediation: Associate an AWS WAF web ACL with every distribution.

detail: Minimum TLS protocol is TLSv1 (require TLSv1.2+).
remediation: Set MinimumProtocolVersion to TLSv1.2_2021.

detail: Distribution access logging is disabled.
remediation: Enable standard/real-time logging to S3.

detail: Distribution uses the default cloudfront.net certificate; serve content under your own domain with an ACM cert.
remediation: Attach an ACM certificate and serve under your domain.

detail: Origin protocol policy is HTTP-only; edge-to-origin traffic is plaintext.
remediation: Set origin protocol policy to HTTPS-only.

check_title: Load balancer uses deprecated SSL policy
detail: Listener uses a deprecated SSL policy (TLS 1.0/1.1 or pre-2016 ciphers).
remediation: Use an ELBSecurityPolicy-TLS-1-2 policy on all listeners.

detail: HTTP listener does not redirect to HTTPS.
remediation: Add a listener rule redirecting HTTP to HTTPS.

detail: All application load balancers have WAF attached.
remediation: Associate a WAF web ACL with the ALB.

check_title: RDS log export to CloudWatch disabled
detail: RDS does not export logs (error/general/slow-query) to CloudWatch.
remediation: Enable CloudWatch log exports on RDS instances.

detail: EKS control plane logging (audit/authenticator) is not enabled.
remediation: Enable audit and authenticator log types.

detail: Log group retention is 30; keep audit logs at least 365 days.
remediation: Set log group retention to >= 365 days (or never expire for compliance logs).

detail: Log group retention is never-expire-but-unset; keep audit logs at least 365 days.
remediation: Set log group retention to >= 365 days (or never expire for compliance logs).

detail: Log group is not encrypted with a KMS key.
remediation: Encrypt log groups with a KMS CMK.

detail: Log group is not encrypted with a KMS key.
remediation: Encrypt log groups with a KMS CMK.

detail: No AWS Backup plans exist; resources rely on per-service backups only.
remediation: Create AWS Backup plans covering critical resources.

detail: Secret uses the default AWS-managed KMS key, not a customer-managed key.
remediation: Encrypt secrets with a customer-managed KMS key.

detail: EBS snapshot is public; any AWS account can copy it and read the data.
remediation: Set snapshot createVolumePermission to private.

check_title: Role trust allows cross-account or wildcard principals
detail: Role trust policy allows principals from another account; verify it is intended and limited.
remediation: Restrict assume-role principals to known accounts/roles.

detail: Bucket has no lifecycle rules; stale objects accumulate cost and risk.
remediation: Define lifecycle rules to expire/transition stale objects.

detail: Bucket has no lifecycle rules; stale objects accumulate cost and risk.
remediation: Define lifecycle rules to expire/transition stale objects.

detail: Function resource policy allows anonymous invoke.
remediation: Remove public resource policies; use API Gateway/IAM auth.

detail: No tables have public policies.
remediation: Remove anonymous principals from table policies.

detail: No geo restriction (whitelist) is configured on the distribution.
remediation: Configure a geo-restriction whitelist on the distribution.

detail: Field-level encryption is not enabled; sensitive fields are delivered to the origin in plaintext.
remediation: Enable field-level encryption and configure encrypted fields.

detail: S3 origin is not locked down with OAC/OAI; the bucket may remain publicly readable.
remediation: Restrict the origin bucket to CloudFront via OAC/OAI.

detail: No CloudWatch dashboards; operational/security metrics have no centralized view.
remediation: Create dashboards for key metrics (errors, throttles, cost).

detail: The CloudTrail log bucket is not encrypted at rest.
remediation: Enable SSE on the CloudTrail bucket (SSE-S3 or SSE-KMS).

detail: CloudTrail is not configured with a KMS CMK for log encryption.
remediation: Configure CloudTrail with a KMS key for log encryption.

detail: EBS snapshot is not encrypted at rest.
remediation: Copy snapshots with encryption enabled and delete the originals.

detail: Instance has a public IP but no security group is attached.
remediation: Attach a restrictive security group to every instance.

detail: Security group is not referenced by any instance.
remediation: Delete unused security groups or document their purpose.

check_title: RDS auto minor version upgrade disabled
detail: Auto minor version upgrade is disabled; known engine fixes are missed.
remediation: Enable auto minor version upgrade on RDS instances.

detail: At least one RDS snapshot is publicly shareable.
remediation: Revoke public sharing on all RDS snapshots.

check_title: Lambda function not in a VPC
detail: Lambda function is not attached to a VPC; it runs on shared AWS-managed network infrastructure.
remediation: Attach Lambda functions to a VPC when they access VPC resources.

detail: X-Ray tracing is disabled; no end-to-end request traces for the function.
remediation: Enable active tracing on Lambda functions.

detail: MFA delete is not enabled; destructive deletes bypass multi-factor authentication.
remediation: Enable MFA delete on versioned buckets (requires a root MFA token).

detail: MFA delete is not enabled; destructive deletes bypass multi-factor authentication.
remediation: Enable MFA delete on versioned buckets (requires a root MFA token).

detail: MFA delete is not enabled; destructive deletes bypass multi-factor authentication.
remediation: Enable MFA delete on versioned buckets (requires a root MFA token).

detail: SNS topic is not encrypted with a KMS key.
remediation: Associate a KMS key with the topic.

check_title: ECR image scanning on push disabled
detail: Image scanning on push is disabled; vulnerabilities are not detected before deploy.
remediation: Enable enhanced scanning on ECR repositories.

detail: No lifecycle policy; stale images accumulate and may retain vulnerable code.
remediation: Add a lifecycle policy to expire old/untagged images.

detail: Queue has no dead-letter queue; failed messages are silently lost.
remediation: Configure a DLQ with a redrive policy.

detail: Classic load balancer has no HTTPS/SSL listener.
remediation: Terminate TLS on the listener or migrate to ALB/NLB with TLS.

detail: Certificate expires in 12 days (< 30); renewal may not complete in time.
remediation: Automate renewal or rotate certificates with > 30 days margin.

detail: DNS query logging is not enabled; resolver queries have no audit trail.
remediation: Enable query logging to CloudWatch Logs.

detail: No AWS Backup vault; backup jobs have no durable destination.
remediation: Create backup vaults and point plans at them.

detail: Container Insights is disabled; no per-task metrics or logs are collected.
remediation: Enable Container Insights on ECS clusters.

check_title: ECS task uses host network mode
detail: Task uses host network mode; containers share the host network stack.
remediation: Use awsvpc network mode for task isolation.

check_title: ECS task definition without execution role
detail: Task definition has no execution role; it cannot fetch secrets or pull images securely.
remediation: Attach an execution role to task definitions.

detail: IoT logging level is INFO; no audit trail of device activity.
remediation: Set IoT logging to ERROR level (or higher verbosity).

detail: IoT policy grants wildcard principals.
remediation: Scope IoT policies to specific certificates/principals.

detail: DKIM is not verified for the identity; spoofing is harder to detect.
remediation: Verify DKIM records for every SES identity.

detail: Deletion protection is disabled; the load balancer can be deleted accidentally.
remediation: Enable deletion protection on ALBs.

detail: No lifecycle policy; infrequently accessed files never move to lower cost tiers.
remediation: Add a lifecycle policy to transition IA files.

detail: Object Lock is disabled; objects can be permanently overwritten or deleted.
remediation: Enable Object Lock (with versioning + retention) on critical buckets.

detail: Object Lock is disabled; objects can be permanently overwritten or deleted.
remediation: Enable Object Lock (with versioning + retention) on critical buckets.

detail: Object Lock is disabled; objects can be permanently overwritten or deleted.
remediation: Enable Object Lock (with versioning + retention) on critical buckets.

detail: Deletion protection is disabled; the table can be dropped accidentally.
remediation: Enable deletion protection on production tables.

detail: S3 protection is disabled; object-level data exfiltration is not monitored.
remediation: Enable S3 protection in the GuardDuty detector.

detail: Enhanced monitoring is disabled; OS-level DB metrics are not collected.
remediation: Enable enhanced monitoring with a 60s granularity.

check_title: SageMaker notebook with direct internet access
detail: Notebook instance has direct internet access; code running in it (or its IAM role) can reach the internet and exfiltrate data.
remediation: Launch notebooks in a VPC-only mode (DirectInternetAccess=Disabled) and route egress through a NAT gateway or VPC endpoint.

detail: Notebook instance root volume is not encrypted with a customer-managed KMS key.
remediation: Create the notebook with a customer-managed KMS key in KmsKeyId on the CreateNotebookInstance call.

detail: Model endpoint has no data capture enabled; request/response payloads are not recorded for monitoring and audit.
remediation: Enable DataCaptureConfig on the endpoint configuration with a sampling percentage and an S3 destination.
